Ravi (People Ops): Heads-up 9:30 PT all-hands next Tue (40m). We'll record. Main items: 1) Launch checklist & GA timeline (Nora) 2) New data access policy summary (Priya) 3) Hiring update + hiring pipeline (Ravi) 4) Customer success callouts. Please post 1-2 questions below or mark :hand: in the event. Calendar: https://cal.example/ah-1735554321 :spiral_calendar_pad:
Sam (CEO): Quick ask: can we keep exec remarks to 5min? I'll highlight top bets and resource asks.
Nora (Product): I'll present Dedicated GA plan, migration recommendations, and rollout dates. Need a short demo clip (45	60s). @Alex can you produce the clip?
Alex (Comms): Yep, I'll stitch the clip and add captions. Target upload by Mon 4pm.
Leo (Eng): Will there be a technical deep dive after? I can host a follow-up office hour.
Ravi (People Ops): Yes 5min office hour immediately after for eng/product follow-ups.
Priya (Security): Heads-up: we'll announce tightened access controls for hosted logs (project-level RBAC by default). Will include a FAQ slide and link to internal policy for comments.
calendar-bot: Event created: "All-hands: Launch + Policy" Tue 09:30 PT. Link: https://cal.example/ah-1735554321
Ravi (People Ops): Please drop Qs by Mon EOD so we can curate the panel. Also add any accommodations.

--- post-call ---
calendar-bot: Recording posted: https://recs.example/1735556000 70% processed captions.
Ravi (People Ops): Top takeaways: 1) Dedicated GA on target June 7; 2) Hosted logs RBAC change will default to project-level for new orgs starting June 14, migration guidelines to follow; 3) Hiring: IC+TM roles open, link in handbook; 4) Action: Product+Security to publish migration plan & FAQ by next Tue. Slides + clip: https://drive.example/allhands-1735556000 :page_facing_up:
Priya (Security): Internal policy draft: https://internal.example/policies/log-access-rbac-v1  comments open for 72h.
Nora (Product): Demo clip is uploaded  ping me with customer impact notes.
Sam (CEO): Great job team. Keep momentum on GA and make the migration experience seamless.
Alex (Comms): Customer-facing brief will be queued for review after GA announcement.
Leo (Eng): Caught up from recording, thanks for captions. Will join the office hour. :thumbsup:
